ov: The largest group of marsupials in the Americas, 126 species, mostly omnivores that spend some time in trees. Only the Virginia opossum lives in the US and Canada, where it’s often called a possum. It’s usually non-aggressive and rarely carries rabies.

why.ac: A solitary nocturnal animal that favours dark, secure dens.
why.et: Hunted for sport and food, and some believe its meat has healing properties.

rg: The Americas, from Canada to South America.
df: A wide range of plants, plus insects (mostly grasshoppers, crickets and beetles), carrion, eggs and small animals.
fx: Gestation lasts only 11–13 days, and a litter can be over 20 young.
Opossums came from South America, and reached North America after the two continents joined.
